name: New York
authority: New York Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
notes: New York requires most applicants to pass a state notary exam (attorneys admitted in New York are exempt). This mock follows the exam's format: 40 multiple-choice questions in one hour, 70% to pass.
disclaimer: Study aid only, not legal advice. Questions are based on New York Executive Law §§130–142-a, Real Property Law §§298–309-b, 19 NYCRR Part 182 and the Department of State's Notary Public License Law booklet. Check the Department of State's current publications before relying on any rule.
